content.short: Eclipse provides Ethereum's fastest L2, powered by the Solana Virtual Machine.
content.description: Eclipse Mainnet is a sophisticated Layer 2 blockchain designed to settle on Ethereum while using ETH to pay gas. It runs the Solana Virtual Machine for fast execution and relies on Celestia to scale data availability. For fraud proofs, it adopts RISC Zero, with no intermediate state serialization required. This architecture delivers high throughput and a smooth development experience, enabling builders to deploy scalable dApps with predictable costs and fast finality across multi-chain scenarios.
